name: Humble Servant of the Unconquered Sun

system.description: Desperate prayer to the Most High for direct aid. All the petitioner's deeds become Obvious to the Unconquered Sun. If judged mostly righteous and facing an insurmountable problem, he dispatches mice of the sun to help. If the problem is within the petitioner's abilities, or the petitioner is insufficiently righteous, the mice instead spread pestilence upon the thaumaturge, companions, and household.
